title: City2TABULA dataset attribution
description: Credits the provider of one source dataset. One attribution.json sits at the root of each dataset folder.

dataset_id.description: Stable identifier of the dataset, unique across all datasets. 3D datasets use <country code>-<region>-<lod>, e.g. cz-brno-lod2.

dataset.description: Name of the dataset as the provider publishes it.

licence.description: SPDX licence id, e.g. CC-BY-4.0, or LicenseRef-<id> for a licence not on the SPDX list.

licence_url.description: Page holding the licence text or the provider's usage rules.

credit.description: Credit line exactly as the provider requires it, shown with any output derived from the dataset.

credit_url.description: Link the provider asks the credit to carry. Omit when the provider names none.

terms_url.description: Provider's terms of use, when separate from the licence.

changes.description: What City2TABULA does to the data, stated wherever the credit is shown.
